name: Skeleton Agent
description: The demo agent that ships with the agent runtime: it answers requests and can call two simple text tools (word count, reverse text).

skills.name: Answer a request
skills.description: Answer a natural-language request, optionally using helper tools, and return a structured answer.
examples: How many words are in 'the quick brown fox'?
Reverse the text 'hello world' and upper-case it.
